allowed_write_sites.reason: Atomically saves only request signatures, exact project binding and recovery observations at runtime/operations/<runtimeId>.json under the caller-supplied nonproject Hub runtime root. No request body or canonical result is stored; P036 alone proves project outcomes.
Atomic replacement shared by the existing account preferences and Hub launch configuration in an explicitly supplied nonproject runtime; neither file contains or writes project state.
The durable project repository is the sole project-document filesystem writer.
Exclusively creates a deterministic Rhino script inside the explicitly supplied non-symlink speculative workspace; saved 3DM output remains non-canonical.

Creates one numbered attempt directory below the run's existing export workspace for an explicitly requested work-model export; nothing canonical is written, nothing is deleted, and a previous attempt is left where it can be read.
Renders DYNAMIC_MAP, the planning index, SYSTEM_MAP and SEMANTIC_REGISTRY from the registries; the files are committed.
Creates the run's speculative workspace directory under the layout's run root before handing it to the runner.
Hands the content-free source-side identities of one archive rehearsal to its later verify phase, beside the restored project and never inside a project the repository owns.
Creates the output directory the verification writes its receipts into.

Creates the per-seat export workspace under the layout's run root, the same way tools/run_project.py does. writes input/runner/program-sheet.json only when POST /api/program carries saveInput=true in local mode; never writes state-record.json
writes only input/runner/seats.json when the caller explicitly saves the authored seat pack; retaining replaced bytes belongs to the caller through project.repository

Create the caller-selected diagnostics directory and shared Hub/Studio journal lock file; no project authority.
Create the caller-supplied desktop-automation trace directory; monkeycontrol has no default location and no project authority.
Append one canonical ComputerActionReceipt@1 line to the action trace inside that directory.
Append one canonical JSON line to a recording's frame index or timeline journal inside that directory.
Write screenshots and recording frames under a temporary name and move them into place inside that directory.
Write recording manifests and other canonical JSON documents atomically inside that directory.
Creates only stdout/stderr logs for this Hub's own service children under its explicit nonproject runtime root; it never writes a project.

Saves chat attachment bytes and atomically saves their transcript metadata and native CLI session ids only under the explicit nonproject Hub runtime/chats directory; design project writes still use existing Studio/P036 interfaces.

Prepares the configured task worktree parent after checking Git branch registration and destination conflicts; Git creates the checkout. No project data or existing worktree is moved, reset or deleted.
Downloads and verifies the fixed embedded runtime only in the caller-selected external cache; an incomplete download is atomically replaced after its checksum matches.
Prepares the embedded interpreter, its import paths and dependency lock only inside the external candidate bundle and cache selected by package().
Assembles the committed application snapshot, locked ACP adapter, selected Node runtime and its upstream license only in the external candidate bundle supplied by package().
Creates explicit external staging/output paths, build metadata and the finalized archive checksum after external() rejects paths inside the selected source checkout.
Retains the locked ACP dependency release notices only under the external candidate bundle third-party directory.

Exclusively writes the Blender transport plan into the explicit speculative workspace; a dedicated worker saves the .blend there and a fresh process reads it. Only the existing runner persists the native receipt through P036.

Holds one OS file lock under the explicit nonproject Hub runtime root across CLI startup and managed worker drain; browser and desktop cannot concurrently rewrite the same Hub chats/config. The lock contains no project state and is released when the actual Hub exits.
Exports print-derived meshes and their assembly table only into the explicitly supplied new or empty output directory. Does not mutate input geometry or P036 project state.
Existing frontend SDK generation writes only disposable OpenAPI schema inputs under the two explicit .generated directories; never project data.
Writes only transport plan and subprocess logs beside OCCT bytes in the supplied speculative workspace. Existing runner retains projection receipts through P036.

forbidden_layer_imports.reason: labs/ is interest-driven exploration: a lab may import the spine, the spine may never import a lab. A lab graduates by becoming a card with an owner in the module registry, and the lab copy is retired in the same change (labs/README.md).
Spine and governance CLIs are the repository's, not an exploration's; a tool that needs a lab's code is asking for that lab to graduate.
The Studio ships to users; a lab is not shipped.
The spine suite is the spine's. A lab's own checks live in that lab.
Reusable framework code cannot import repository tooling, tests, or documentation modules. Probe imports are rejected by the dedicated probe reverse-import rule.
Repository tools cannot acquire implementation or fixtures from the test suite.
The public spine suite must not depend on retired lane code. Retired source and its tests are kept outside the public checkout; the import guard prevents reintroducing that dependency.
Canonical contract primitives may depend on project identity only, never on higher domain, control, runtime, or adapter layers.
External-world protocols may depend on stable identity contracts, never on their concrete adapters, orchestration, control, or validation implementations.
Evidence records cannot acquire retrieval implementation, validation, orchestration, or stage-control authority.
Research selection and indexing cannot depend on runtime orchestration, concrete adapters, validation, or control.
Material intent and binding validation cannot depend on project runners, orchestration, or concrete adapters.
The control plane consumes typed receipts but cannot depend on concrete adapters or runtime orchestration.
A read-only evaluator cannot acquire commit repository or hard-gate authority.
Hard validation cannot commit or depend on soft evaluation.
Detached experts and capabilities cannot acquire persistence or promotion authority.

The Project Runtime (archflow_studio_api) validates requests, streams events and manages task lifecycle; design state, dependencies, validation, geometry and commit are calls into archflow. Geometry mathematics, graphs, .3dm writing and state schemas live in archflow and are imported, never reimplemented beside it. Pydantic models here are transport shapes, not a second canonical state.
The shared ArchFlow core provides facts, persistence and CAD contracts; it cannot depend on either workflow.
The 3D workflow uses ArchFlow contracts and ports; the host coordinates drawing handoffs. Project-specific data and tooling are not runtime dependencies.
The drawing workflow consumes retained source contracts through ArchFlow; it cannot import 3D workflow internals or project-specific code.
Detached modeling capabilities cannot acquire persistence or promotion authority.
Geometry compilation returns a domain value and has no project writer.
The independent usage and pricing tool receives plain values; project and workflow execution remain with their owners.
Fab owns print preparation and upload-only CLI behavior; the Hub composes applications and P036 alone owns project state.
Desktop automation receives plain action values and writes only receipts under a caller-supplied diagnostics directory; the spine, both workflows and the Hub never become its dependencies.
